caption: The drawing depicts a square textile pattern composed of various colored sections arranged in a geometric layout. The central area forms a large, light beige diamond with subtle quilted stitching patterns visible across the surface. Surrounding the central diamond, there are triangular and quadrilateral patches in alternating colors and prints, including dark brown with white floral designs, solid red, red with yellow and blue patterns, as well as off-white and beige sections with finer linear or geometric designs. The brown and red patches appear at each corner, bordered by the lighter beige segments. Smaller printed fabric pieces with floral and leafy motifs in muted tones are also integrated into the overall pattern, emphasizing the composition’s symmetry. The background of the drawing is plain, and the textile fills most of the image area.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
